SDL_ProgressState.note: Header claims \since 3.2.8; absent from every 3.2.x through 3.2.30. The empirical floor is 3.4.0.

SDL_PinchFingerEvent.note: No \since upstream at all; first appears in 3.4.0.

SDL_StretchSurface.note: Header claims \since 3.4.0; present since 3.2.4. Correcting keeps the function live on 3.2.4+ instead of stubbing it.

SDL_SENSOR_COUNT.note: First observed in the matrix between 3.2.16 and 3.2.30; inclusive upper bound recorded (over-gating a sentinel is harmless).

SDL_COLORSPACE_YUV_DEFAULT.note: 3.2: = SDL_COLORSPACE_JPEG; 3.4: = SDL_COLORSPACE_BT601_LIMITED. A real semantic change, also documented in the package README.

SDL_MouseWheelEvent.note: integer_x/integer_y added in 3.2.12; sizeof 48 -> 56, so the size/alignment asserts carry the same gate.

SDL_GPUMultisampleState.note: Member slotted into existing padding; sizeof unchanged.

SDL_GPUDepthStencilTargetInfo.note: Members slotted into existing padding; sizeof unchanged.

SDL_CameraPermissionState.note: enum; SDL_GetCameraPermissionState exists at 3.2 returning int (retype)

SDL_HapticEffectID.note: typedef int upstream; the six 3.2-era haptic-effect functions retype to it at 3.4

SDL_GPUDevice.note: Exists at 3.2 but unreachable from the SDL_render.h wrapper TU's single include.

SDL_PropertiesID.note: Exists at 3.2 but unreachable from the SDL_hidapi.h wrapper TU's single include.
